[2026-09-26T18:26:23+00:00] A RE-INSERTED IFRAME RELOADS, AND replaceChildren() RE-INSERTS EVERYTHING. The Shaders page's WebGL stage went black for ~2 s on every Commit and every ‹ ›, because route() rebuilt #content and the iframe came out and went back in. The fix is general and six lines: mountView() — a view renders an empty slot with data-keep="<id>" and the live element of that id is MOVED into it with moveBefore() (Chrome 133+/Firefox 144+ preserve iframe state across an atomic move) while both are in the document: new view in first, old tree out last. Fallback: an ordinary append (a reload), which the page's own reconcile on shaders:ready brings back as he left it — gated both ways. Any view with a live player can use the slot.

[2026-09-26T18:26:23+00:00] THE WIKI'S LIVE FILES COME THROUGH /api/live/state, NOT THE STATIC PATHS.
